objective: Preallocate column-scan aggregate index-probe prefixes from known component lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate column-scan index-probe prefixes
tasks.result: Column-scan aggregate index probes now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for index:<table>:<column>:<value>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for index:<table>:<column>:<value>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in column-scan aggregate indexed predicate probe prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, index scans, row-id extraction, row fetches, aggregate state updates, predicate filtering, and SQL results are unchanged.
